info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to update deposit lending details for corporate lease accounts based on specific parameters. It facilitates modifications to existing lending terms, enabling enhanced management of financial agreements. Typical consumers include banking professionals and financial analysts who require up-to-date information for corporate lending operations. This endpoint serves as a vital tool for maintaining accurate and timely data in corporate finance applications.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific corporate lease identified by the resource ID. Use this endpoint to modify lease terms, conditions, or any relevant information for better alignment with business needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update an existing corporate lease with specified changes. The provided data will dictate the modifications to be made to the lease identified by RES-100045.
